codeReview.summary: Implementation satisfies the feature intent: smart approve now approves all waiting panes (and no longer returns a zero-approval confirmation), repair uses a single unambiguous --execute switch with dry-run default, and delete confirmation skipping is separated from branch deletion via --yes/--force alias vs --delete-branches. Added integration coverage directly exercises all three fixes.

issues.description: A test-only helper (`inject_pane_status`) is exposed as a public production API (with `#[doc(hidden)]`) rather than being test-gated. This works, but it weakens the architecture invariant that runtime status should be derived from watcher inputs.

sharedStateObservations.observation: There is no documented repository convention for exposing test helpers for status injection; worker introduced public hidden APIs in core/watcher to support integration tests.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: src/core/status_engine.rs:323-326 and src/monitor/watcher.rs:499-502 add public `inject_pane_status`; .factory/library/architecture.md states status should be derived from watcher state.

sharedStateObservations.observation: rust-worker's strict RED-first guidance does not clearly account for CLI-binary flag tests and other cases where implementation-first can be pragmatic before parser-level integration assertions are possible.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Handoff skillFeedback.suggestedChanges explicitly requests updating guidance: 'Write failing tests first (RED)' was hard to apply for the CLI flag scenario.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Testing approach for multi-pane waiting status in integration tests is not captured in shared library docs, causing exploratory churn in transcript before settling on a status injection approach.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Transcript skeleton contains repeated investigation around StatusEngine/SessionWatcher status injection before implementation; no corresponding guidance exists in .factory/library/user-testing.md testing patterns.

summary: Reviewed commit ad3f0c4 for feature fix-smart-approve-and-cli-flags: behavior changes align with description/expectedBehavior and test coverage is strong. Marked pass with one non-blocking design concern about production-visible test injection hooks and shared-state documentation/skill guidance gaps.
